# Qwertycoin

> Qwertycoin (QWC) is a privacy-focused cryptocurrency with RandomX mining
> and EPoSe rewards for proven network services.

- The QWC mainnet is live.
- RandomX miners produce blocks and secure the blockchain.
- The QWC block subsidy is split 90% to mining and 10% to EPoSe service
  rewards; transaction fees remain with the miner.
- EPoSe determines Service Node qualification and reward selection from
  valid registrations and attestations recorded on the blockchain.
- Service Nodes do not require QWC staking.
- The official RandomX pool uses transparent PPLNS accounting. It allocates
  95% of its distributable mining rewards to participating miners and retains
  a 5% fee for Qwertycoin development and pool operations.
- The Web Wallet and Qwertycoin core source code are available.
- The current network is separate from the earlier QWC chain.

## Official resources

- [Website](https://qwertycoin.org/): Project overview in English.
- [Deutsch](https://qwertycoin.org/de/): Projektübersicht auf Deutsch.
- [Web Wallet](https://wallet.qwertycoin.org/): Browser wallet.
- [Explorer](https://explorer.qwertycoin.org/): Blockchain explorer.
- [Official mining pool](https://pool.qwertycoin.org/): RandomX PPLNS pool,
  live statistics and guided XMRig setup.
- [Documentation](https://docs.qwertycoin.org/): Current wallet, mining,
  node, EPoSe and integration documentation.
- [Core source](https://github.com/qwertycoin-org/qwertycoin): Public core repository.
- [GitHub organization](https://github.com/qwertycoin-org): Official project organization.
